opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants (UK)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring together UK and Japan collaborators across arts, culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport, to deepen mutual understanding and develop lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for up to three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must propose a UK‑Japan collaborative project in medicine or health; preference for those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
